promotion_gate.reason: All 18 examples have explicit 2024 Air values and strong permit identity support, but the direct official raw 2024 PI ZIP row and an exact scan of the current 457-row canonical registry were not completed. GitHub indexed search returned no hits but is not accepted as conclusive.
required_before_promotion: Read the exact official 2024 PI raw row from the Environment Agency ZIP
Match permit, year, route, substance, quantity and method
Complete an exact canonical duplicate scan against the current 457-row registry
Keep parcel binding absent until verified title geometry exists

quality.numeric_confidence_policy: Secondary EA PI reproductions remain capped at 98 until a direct official raw PI row is read.
quality.identity_confidence_policy: Direct Environment Agency permit/register identity evidence is 100; EA-derived compliance index evidence is 99.
quality.duplicate_policy: No numeric example is promoted without an exact current canonical duplicate scan.
